item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"C1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The default ChatAdapter has JSON fallback enabled by default and, if its normal call path raises, it retries the full adapter call by invoking JSONAdapter with the same LM, kwargs, signature, demos, and inputs.","span_ids":["S1","S2"]},{"claim_id":"C2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"ChatAdapter.parse only recognizes output fields introduced by the `[[ ## field ## ]]` header pattern and raises AdapterParseError when a required output field is missing or a field value cannot be parsed.","span_ids":["S3"]},{"claim_id":"C3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The automatic JSON fallback is explicitly bypassed for ContextWindowExceededError, when the adapter instance is already JSONAdapter, or when use_json_adapter_fallback is disabled; in those cases the original exception is re-raised.","span_ids":["S2"]},{"claim_id":"C4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":20,"statement":"JSONAdapter.parse can accept JSON-object responses by loading or repairing JSON, optionally extracting a JSON object substring, then filtering to declared output fields, coercing values to the signature annotations, and requiring that all output fields be present.","span_ids":["S4"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"S1","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":28,"end_line":55},{"span_id":"S2","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":63,"end_line":85},{"span_id":"S3","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":211,"end_line":246},{"span_id":"S4","path":"dspy/adapters/json_adapter.py","start_line":148,"end_line":181}]}
